source: McAuley Amazon Reviews 2023（公开研究数据集）
reviews: Needed a new router with a better signal and this one had good reviews plus it was inexpensive. Very easy to set up and add devices to the server. Overall the signal is much stronger in the house.

I've tried them all, and Fire TV is undoubtedly the easiest to install, configure, and use.  With a subscription to Netflix, you are set for life with more movies and TV series than you could ever watch.  I love the voice activated Alexa info service, as well as the excellent voice search features of the system.  It just doesn't get any better than Fire TV from Amazon.

You can count on Netgear for the best in wireless devices. This one is perfect for small businesses or personal use. It's very small, so it can be placed pretty much anywhere. The setup couldn't be easier. You're ready to go in five minutes or less. If you should need it, customer service is excellent. I highly recommend this product.

Thanks so much for taking the time to read this review. I hope the information that I've provided helps make your decision a little easier.

It looks good, but the buttons are abysmal and "mushy". Most often, you have to press multiple times to get a function to work. It takes about 10 presses just to get the TV on or off. Yes, my TCL Roku model is on the approved list and I tried 2 sets of fresh batteries. It's going back.

(Updated review) This TV is very nice! Its a good size for the dresser in the bedroom. I purchased it in the spring of 2017 for my vacation rental home and have had no customer complaints! Customers signed up for a roku account and got right onto their netflix accounts.
I just purchased a second 32 inch TV for my home to replace an older outdated tube tv. Looking forward to getting it.... update! Just got my second tv set up and enjoying my shows! Great picture too.
Fast shipping and great price I bought it for one reason and was to run it under my house to my router for my xbox and it moves my xbox slim faster than the wi fi would

I used this to mount a 65” fire tv. Took me about an hour from start to finish. Instructions are fine and if your generally a handy person it shouldn’t be a difficult job. I did get some help when I put the TV on, so not a full one person job. Work well and is very adjustable. Overall very pleased.

My wife -- who may not be a video expert but who uses this TV more than I do -- loves this TV. She says the picture is so good compared to our retired old Sony 720p that she wants to watch old movies again to see the detail she didn't see the first time.

The wifi connection works well and streams Prime and other services from the router two rooms away. Is very small and light. Has an annoying red light that flashes near the power button on the bottom whenever it's turned off.

You may be familiar with WAVLINK due to the popularity of their routers and extenders. I wasn't aware that they also made docking stations. Turns out it's pretty good. The only thing is that it's not universal. Make sure you read the details to make sure it's compatible with your device. Other than that, I highly recommend this product.

Thanks so much for taking the time to read this review. I hope the information that I've provided helps make your decision a little easier.

This was intended to function as a charging hub. I have 2 tablets, 2 headphones, a WiMax Router, an ebook reader, a battery pack, and a smart phone - All of which uses USB to charge. This item wasn't meeting the demands. I am sure it will make a good USB data hub, but nothing else. Don't expect it to power much of anything in turn.

Although i wish i had bought the better Netgear N900 (WNDR4500v2)
or the AC1750 i am VERY pleased with this N750. It was very easy to
setup initially and use. I tend to like to use my own settings and it didn't
like what i chose but overall i couldn't be Happier!! Great Product NetGear!!

I have a Roku and a Nintendo switch that I needed to connect to my one HDMI input on the tv. The Roku worked just fine but the nintendo would not. The Nintendo worked just fine when connected directly to the tv with the same cable. I swapped inputs at this device,  the Roku still worked using the other side but not the Nintendo.  I tried plugging just the Nintendo into this device and it still would not put out the video.

TVs should come with at least 2 remotes. We're up to 5+ remotes for the same TV now. 2 broke (including the original), and now that we have a toddler, they just end up missing. I wish these were sold in 12 packs for those with kids.

If I could buy a Roku remote without those stupid buttons on the bottom, that would be a huge improvement. That's the only reason why this loses 1 star, otherwise it works well for its intended use.

This product got the job done. My router is in the basement where I am but it was making it hard for my brother on the 2nd floor to receive consistent latency so I bought this repeater and it fixed the issue! He's receiving a consistent connection now and the product worked just as advertised!

I ended up just downloading a free Roku app onto my phone because this is the 2nd faulty controller that I’ve ordered from Amazon. The scroll right button works on and off, and often redirects me to download more apps.. it’s frustrating. Wouldn’t suggest anyone buying this. Save your money

Works great in my condo.  Had a lot of trouble getting wifi in the back section of my home since there are so many other routers nearby that interfear.  At $29.99 on lightning deals it was a great buy, much cheaper than best buy.  Very easy to install if you follow the directions.

I have a home that’s just over 2000 sqft. It work great in every room and even a great distance from outside the house. I have over 28 devices connected 22 wirelessly. We haven’t had any issue streaming movies form 6 devices at the same time, some of those being 4k content. Parental controls work well and are easy to setup. Overall very pleased with this router.

Very easy to activate with Comcast/Xfinity. It maybe took me 20 minutes if that.
I read many reviews and glad they helped me decide and did the leg work for me. Otherwise I would have spent months on research.
This is to replace my 6 year old cable modem that Comcast/Xfinity no longer support. I am hoping to get more years from this than 6.
Now I need to replace my router.

I worked for 2 days trying to hook up to my computer.  So frustrating.  Amazon helped by putting me in touch with Netgear company and could hardly understand her and not helpful or polite!  Netgear is not helpful unless you already have a degree in technology which I don't.  Rude!  So pleased that Amazon worked with me and I got a full refund.  Would never buy anything from Netgear again. But I love Amazon!  Nice customer service.

We just got it today and couldn't wait to try it out. It does not connect straight to an android phone. I had to connect the Chromecast to the projector, but from there it was a breeze to get the movie playing. Great picture! I'm very satisfied with the purchase. Can't wait to have movie night outside!

We had to move a desktop from an office to a home office that only had Wifi.  I installed this on their desktop and tested it in the office and everything worked great with now issues.  We moved it to our employees home and it connects great to his home router.  Size is wonderful, functionality is great, has been consistent for him.  This has proven to be everything I would want in a USB Wifi adapter.
So far a very solid router and easy to use. Easily reaching the max speed of my tier of internet without noise in the line and lag that I previously had with my Spectrum wifi modem.
Just what I needed! Roku is so awesome! I have 5 Roku in my house and a amazon fire stick though I’ve not played with my fire stick yet I love the roku!

I bought this cause i wanted the best that my Wallet could buy and
still get a great router for my Whole house and handle all my devices and as well as
streaming. love this baby and may upgrade with the same manufacture.
Great job Netgear!!
Works great in my Roku

Bought this hoping it would take advantage of my fios gigabit but have been very disappointed, best I can squeeze out of it is about 500 with cat 6. I have measured the speed with my old router and can get 900 out of it, I can get 980 when I hook up striaght to the fios box.I tried all different configs no QOS etc and different firmware but no difference, so I am positive it is the router that is under performing.  I would not recommend this router.

I installed this device in a known good USB port on my computer. The pilot light on the adapter did not illuminate and the device would not connect to my wireless router. I sent it back. The adapter is worthless!

This NetGear Extender brought our bedrooms into the WiFi world. With this extender we can now access our WiFi network in our bedrooms. Before our bedrooms were to far away from our modem to even get on the network. We now have a full signal in everyone of our bedrooms. Setup was very easy and with the ease of plugging the extender into a regular electrical outlet there are no wires to run and it isn't huge or unattractive. I am very happy with this NetGear Extender.

This is my 6th TCL TV between home & business. An amazing value.
But ...
This is my first with a Roku attached & there was no workaround to use the TV without signing up for ROKY & that was a PITA
I had to give my credit card info, etc.
I had to input on the TV as well as a browser (various codes, pw, info, etc.)
There might be a workaround, but I could not find it & should not have to do all that just to be able to see something through the AV cables (not included)

Ran out of HDMI connections on our older TV so needed something to switch between a Blu Ray drive and a Roku device.  Put the switch in line, connected the cables from the Blu Ray player and Roku.  Works fine.  Since the Roku is powered on all the time and the Blu Ray must be powered on and off, the switch from one to the other is automatic.

The echo dot (3rd Gen) is pretty nice. I love the new look and for the size the sound is pretty decent with just enough bass for me. It was very easy to setup. I'm really happy with it so far. I paired it with my fire TV and it works just fine. I'm going to get some smart plugs and smart light bulbs next.

I already own a ROKU that I am very happy with. I purchased this to play my movies in HD. It suits my purpose. Someday I will set up the WI-FI and check it out, but right now I have no interest in it....

It worked seamlessly with our TCL Roku tv.
Just tuck in batteries and it was recognized quickly.
No problems at all with this product.

tried two other routers: they worked for a while but begain to loose their continuity: I read upom the TP-LINK Router and liked the specs and the price wasn't bad either: connected the first time and have not expirienced any problems even when we lost power... router came back up with noooo problems
I bought this for adding wired Ethernet to the Google Chromecast with Google TV and it works perfectly. No more lagging connection.
This wireless router makes it very convenient to use my mobile devices.

I can't fault the product for me buying the wrong one.  I have a ROKU TV and this remote is for a ROKU box. No worries. I bought my Mom the box and now she has 2 remotes. I did order the TV remote and all is working well now.  Sometimes you just have to LOL and go with it. Hope this saves someone from making the same mistake I did.

Alexa will turn Fire TV on and off and that is it. I been working with that control for days, it just seen to be a forgein object to my TV I have  " Primete control and it works just fine with the buttoms. I am disgusted for buying this useless clicker.

The Netgear Righthawk router extender, works great at the speeds specified as an independent router, but it doesn't seem to perform correctly as a wifi extender with my linksys router.  It might perform better with the same name brand router.

The specs are covered in the description. The installation was quick and simple for first time users. We were able to change the IP from the default 192.168.1.0 to a more secure IP range without issue or confusion. Changing the SSID, username, and password were straightforward as well.

The tri-band Wi-Fi on the Linksys ensures a stronger connection with multiple wireless devices compared to the TP-Link's dual band
